headline: Continued review of the 34-window replacement at 6 Front Street, 4-0, pending more information on mullion sizing.
summary: The applicant proposed replacing 34 second- and third-floor windows at 6 Front Street with vinyl double pane windows. Members said the proposed mullions were thicker than the originals, and the applicant said he would research other options. Members voted 4-0 to continue the review and requested more information.
decisions: Continued the review of the 34-window replacement at 6 Front Street, 4-0, with the requested information on mullion pattern sizing and new versus existing windows.

DRB 
August 5, 2026 
Page 1 of 2 
 
City of Salem Massachusetts 
Public Meeting Minutes 
 
Board or Committee:   Design Review Board, Special Meeting 
Date and Time:    Wednesday, August 5, 2026 at 6:00 pm 
Meeting Location:   Virtual Zoom Meeting 
DRB Members Present: Chair Paul Durand, Daniel Estes, Marc Perras, and Sarah Tarbet 
Others Present: Stephanie Owens, Senior Planner 
Recorder:  Christine Petryszyn 
 
 
Projects in the Urban Renewal Area 
1. 6 Front Street: Small Project Review – Replacement of 34 windows on the second and third floors of 
the property.  
 
Ben Goldberg was present to discuss the proposal: 
• The applicant noted that the existing windows are old, wood single pane. He would like to 
replace them with a vinyl double pane set with simulated divided lights to match what is 
existing.  
• The paint would also match the existing color.  
• Renderings were shared.  
• The windows are on the second and third floor above Orchid, Nocturne, and a coffee house.  
• The applicant noted the existing windows are in very poor condition.  
• The first-floor windows have all been redone or reglazed. The second-floor windows are in the 
worst shape so that want to begin the project with those. A phase 2 is expected. The scope of 
work was reduced once cost estimates were received.  
• A sample window was shared.  
• Mr. Durand noted the proposed mullion thickness is thicker than the original and that there may 
be more lights than appropriate for the size of the windows. He believes the proposed windows 
will look too heavy for the façade.  
• Ms. Tarbet agreed and suggested a window replacement that would be more similar to the 
existing.  
• The applicant said he would research better options.  
• Mr. Perras noted that it is not a full replacement, that some of the existing windows will remain.  
• Mr. Durand recommended a window that matches the frame dimensions as well.  
• Mr. Perras said it would be helpful to have a drawing for the new window and typical existing 
window side by side with dimensions. He said it would also be helpful to see an example of the 
window in a brick façade in any building.  
• Ms. Tarbet asked about the profile of the existing window frame and whether it matches the 
existing. The applicant noted the window was recommended  by the contractor.  
 
There were no comments or questions from members of the public.  
 
 VOTE: Mr. Perras made a motion to continue with the information requested regarding mullion 
pattern sizing and of new proposed as opposed to existing.

 Seconded by Tarbet.   
Roll Call: Estes, Perras, Tarbet, and Durand. 4-0 in favor. 
  
 
Adjournment 
 
VOTE: Ms. Tarbet made a motion to adjourn. Seconded by: Perras. All in favor.  
 
The meeting adjourned at 6:15PM.
